Avalonia parity ledger

The single source of truth for "done" in the WPF -> Avalonia 12 port. One row per WPF window, view, dialog, control, theme dictionary, shell partial and platform feature. The WPF head (ConditioningControlPanel/) is the reference: a row is done when the Avalonia counterpart matches it or is better, and is at least as fast.

Status, lowest to highest:

  • missing: no Avalonia counterpart.
  • stub: a counterpart exists but key behaviour is a placeholder, unwired or unavailable.
  • wired: the counterpart implements the WPF behaviour as far as the source shows, and something in the Avalonia head opens or hosts it. Not yet proven. A surface nothing opens is stub, and so is one missing a WPF animation or motion effect.
  • verified: proven on Linux by a headless test or render proof AND a Keincheck run on the live app (navigate, click, read state, screenshot), compared against the WPF reference. Evidence linked.
  • improved: verified, and deliberately better than WPF; the reason is in avalonia-decisions.html.
  • blocked: cannot progress yet; the blocker is in the notes. Revisit later.
  • resolved: a contract/decision row (no surface of its own) whose blocker was answered; answer and date in the notes.

--render-all (RenderProof) only proves a view draws; it never makes a row verified on its own. Initial statuses were read from source on 2026-09-28 (stack tip #1765) and are not yet verified.

Locking a row: a verified/improved row must have a snapshot, or the gate fails (ledger-snapshot-check.sh). Add the row id and its window to Rows in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Snapshot.Tests/VerifiedRowSnapshotTests.cs, run that project once, read Snapshots/<row-id>.received.png, rename it (and the .received.txt tree) to .verified.*. It renders through the RenderProof setup (Inter, Skia, Motion off, throwaway profile) with the bundled Noto Emoji pinned as the fallback font, so it matches on ubuntu-latest, and compares by SSIM 0.995. Accept a new or changed baseline only with the WPF side-by-side image path in the commit message.

Starting totals (2026-09-28): 362 rows: 59 missing, 247 stub, 56 wired, 0 verified.

Merge reconciliation: one row per ID, with evidence from both lanes retained. Advanced implementation statuses take precedence; historical absence claims are superseded by later implementation details. No row is promoted to verified by this merge.

Notes carry what is stubbed or missing, platform-specific parts, existing evidence and, where it matters, a performance note (startup, tab switch, list scroll, overlays, media).

Ported 2026-11-05 (Linux beta 1, lane shell; #3294 landed): the manual restore re-cut. One shared request guard, a session refusal after the download and the latest local state kept (WPF MainWindow.CloudBackup.cs:108-168); a stricter restore floor for StrictLock*, panic and OCR; the Lab entitlement left out of the upload and kept local (WPF MainWindow.CloudBackup.cs:155); secret-name exclusions filtered before deserialization; the local tier reading kept; relative active-asset and preset separators. Only downloaded presets are normalized, so a refused restore leaves the local presets untouched, and a backup without the trigger preset list keeps this machine's presets while an empty list in the backup clears them (WPF ProfileSyncService.cs:4484-4485). Tests: CloudSettingsBackupTests safety, entitlement, secret, path and filter cases; AccountSettingsSectionTests cloud session-race, request-serialization, latest-local-state and RefusedCloudRestoreLeavesLocalPresetsUntouched. Still missing: the startup restore prompt's restore and flavour rows, as above. Recovered profile upload guard: CCP.Core/Services/Account/SyncPush.cs:226 and CCP.Core/Services/Account/RecoveredProfileReconcile.cs:11 read before push, preserve skills and save before clearing the marker; WPF ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Settings/ProfileSyncService.cs:1220 and ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Settings/ProfileSyncService.cs:1304. Rollover clears seasonal streak and quest latches while retaining skills and fix charges (CCP.Core/Services/Account/RecoveredProfileReconcile.cs:22; WPF ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Progression/SkillTreeService.cs:732); recovery progression changes repaint the shell (CCP.Avalonia/App.axaml.cs:90; WPF ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Settings/ProfileSyncService.cs:251). The silent monthly bookkeeping nudge remains missing (WPF ConditioningControlPanel/MainWindow/MainWindow.Marquee.cs:271); other gaps above remain. Restack b10 (#4602): welcome-back restore and flavour: the offer peeks the cloud backup (one info + one download, once, fresh install with a cloud identity only) and applies it only after an explicit choice, queued on the startup ladder (CCP.Avalonia/Platform/WelcomeBackOffer.cs); startup merge CCP.Core/Services/Settings/CloudSettingsBackup.cs PrepareWelcomeBackRestore. WPF ConditioningControlPanel/App.xaml.cs:4938-5011, 5153-5263. Remaining: server contract confirmation; status remains stub.

All five WPF acts with WPF timings, fonts and colours: GlitchHeal (Core MarqueeGlyphRot, moved from WPF; cyan/magenta ghosts, 48 ms heal ticks, 3 jitter frames), NumberFirst (odometer roll, shrink into its slot), Teletype (Press Start 2P, blinking cursor, tag snap + 3 px nudge), NeonWarmUp (discrete flicker frames, tag GlowBreath), Redaction (bars slide off word by word). MainShellWindow.Possession.cs is the stage (WPF MainWindow.Possession.cs): ghost layer over RootGrid, the A1 auto-tag walk (hand tags PossessionTree.Role/Name, WPF's never-names, type inference, leaf rule, innermost card, window-pixel size and placement, 24 labels, target objects cached per control, 250 ms layout flag / 750 ms floor / 10 s max age, UI thread only), IsUsable (minimized, GameWindow, intake host, Emergency Exit, Chaos run, Lock Card), pointer tracking, attach on Opened and detach on Closed; plus the Lockdown readout and first-run rules (see views-tab-lockdown). EmberAttribution (WPF EmberAttribution): charge before anything moves (400 ms; a still tint held 600 ms under photosafe, Gentle or motion Off), a possessed outline that follows the moved control, the refcounted cursor ring, the edge pulse (at most 3; still mode 0.5 and 900 ms) and ReleaseAll; frame-stepped, no Animation objects and no Effects (WPF's glow and blur become a flat fill and an inset BoxShadow); a charge whose frames stop (window minimized mid-charge) ends on the wall clock 5 s past its length, so the director's pick slot can never stall (asserted by build only). DirectedHeadEffect bridges the four ported effects (nudge, drift, breathe, wobble) to the Core contract with WPF PossessionEffectBase's grammar (charge, name, possess, apply; undo eases home over up to 600 ms); PossessionRuntime gained the director-held mode (Return). The tripwire shake is WPF App.ScreenShake's port, Views/Deeper/ScreenShake (skipped under photosafe by the director, stopped by panic row screen-shake). Panic surface possession also runs the director's UndoAll (every ghost undone, ember stripped). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/PossessionShellTests.cs (9): readout follows the real lockdown tick, room walk / never-names / target identity, bridged effect charges first then holds then eases home, the real director haunts the shell and panic gives it back, rules card, consent text, repeated tripwire pulses and shakes (not under photosafe), edge pulses and ReleaseAll. PanicKeyRebindTests now invokes the actual registered callback with a scoped desktop-shell lifetime fixture; startup sync preserves a prior portal refusal, while explicit re-enable retries. LeashHoldTests restores the no-effect/no-live-hold release checks. Second-gate fail-proofs: whole-leash retention restored = 4 failed; callback deliberately routed to release = both re-enable cases failed with effects still running; unconditional startup failure reset restored = 1 failed. All mutations restored. Focused suite = 14 passed. Status remains stub because existing notes still list missing WPF behavior. No live compositor retest claimed. Second-gate final validation: affected Avalonia suite 83 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed; Core 4635 passed / 6 skipped; Core, Avalonia and test builds passed; core-guards and avalonia_docs passed; ten language files validated with unchanged decision-C hints. R72 effects/leash route correction (2026-10-31): WPF MainWindow.xaml.cs:878-881,2329-2330 preserves leash-only escape with panic off or Lockdown active. PanicRouteWanted now means panic enabled OR leashed, separately from decision C: KeepPortalBound still requires running effects or a live portal hold. The setting sync and effect-start gate use that same route predicate. This clarifies the earlier second-gate evidence: panic-off releases only when neither the panic route nor the leash route is needed; leash membership alone never keeps an idle grab. LeashedEffectsKeepPortalWhenPanicIsDisabled covers settings/Lockdown both before effect start and during effects, verifies the idle poll retains the route, then verifies release when effects stop while still leashed. Earlier evidence is retained as history; no live Wayland retest claimed. Effects/leash route validation: focused suite 18 passed; removing the leash term from PanicRouteWanted made all four new cases fail (two lost bindings during effects; two missing binds when already disabled). The mutation was restored before final checks. Effects/leash route final checks: affected Avalonia safety/isolation suite 87 passed / 1 skipped / 0 failed; Core 4635 passed / 6 skipped; Core, Avalonia and test builds passed; core-guards, avalonia_docs, append-only ledger check and all ten language-file checks passed. Linux: with an X11 window focused, XInput2 and the portal both report one press, which took the double-press exit rung on a single Escape. PanicRouteGate (Core) drops the other route's count within 500 ms, once per press; a real double press still exits. The dropped report still runs its own route's work: both routes arm the watchdog unless the press is refused (panic off, Lockdown, key capture), and a portal echo restarts the leash hold as the portal's. Live runs on Hyprland and KWin were at 29d45312d, before the later hold ordering and fault path changes. A faulted press handler is logged, as WPF does. Tests PanicRouteGateTests, PanicRouteTests, LeashHoldTests. Live on Hyprland (sandboxed build forced to hold the portal, injected Escape): three taps and three 800 ms holds each counted once with the portal report dropped, and two presses 344 ms apart exited. On a nested KWin 6.7 with the real KDE portal, KWin consumes the bound key, so only the portal reports: the same taps and holds counted once each, and two presses 344 ms apart exited. No leash was live in those runs, so the hold path is proven headless only.

shell-single-instanceConditioningControlPanel/App.xaml.cs:2056-2223,4069-4074,4157-4217CCP.Avalonia/Platform/SingleInstance.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Program.cswiredNot verified. Named mutex, per-profile pipe and launcher surface handoff retained, including the base Unix mutex scope across sessions. Ported startup early ack until successful desktop startup completion, including intermediate splash frames and stale takeover after the 10 s ack timeout, with a bounded 3 s mutex wait and secondary fallback. Kill requires the app executable, a readable identical image path and a provably identical profile; shared dotnet/testhost processes and unknown profiles are skipped. Windows and Unix identify profiles through a process-lifetime mutex marker keyed by PID, start time and profile suffix. Missing or inaccessible markers are skipped. Tests: SingleInstanceTests, including healthy, wedged, failed kill, cold start, mutex reacquisition, exact build and profile isolation. Original fail-proofs disabled kill and early ack and weakened identity guards. Review fix: SingleInstanceProcessTests runs real child apphosts through production target selection, kill, mutex takeover and relaunch ack while protecting other profiles, other builds and missing markers. Real-process fail-proofs reject skip-all and allow-all profile checks. Startup review fix: SplashStartupTests.StartupThatPumpsThenBlocksStillAcknowledgesRelaunches covers a dispatcher pump followed by a blocking initialization step beyond the ack timeout; failed startup never signals completion. The startup fail-proof restores the premature dispatcher callback and fails the regression test. Visual splash tests compiled but are blocked here by Inter glyphTypeface creation. Windows API paths compile; Windows runtime testing remains pending. Open with CCP: --play/--edit go through Core DeeperFileOpen as a deeper: payload on the extended frame and LauncherWindow.RouteHandoff (first launch App.QueuePendingDeeperFileOpen). Small WPF deviation: a handoff that arrives before the shell has opened is queued and routed once it opens (Platform/HandoffQueue.cs; App.RouteHandoffsOnceOpened). WPF App.xaml.cs:2226-2229 consumes a handoff only once its main window exists, so one sent during a cold start stays on disk until the next relaunch there. Senders are serialized by a per-pipe mutex, so launches racing each other (several files opened at once) no longer time out against a busy listener and lose their request (SingleInstance.RequestShow). An open failure shows its dialog with the panel hidden too, ownerless and centred (MainShellWindow.DeeperImport.cs ReportDeeperOpenError; WPF MainWindow.DeeperTab.cs:613-616,664-667). Tests: HandoffQueueTests, DeeperFollowupTests.AMediaHandoffBeforeTheShellOpensIsRoutedOnceItOpens and OpenErrorsShowWithThePanelHidden, SingleInstanceTests.ConcurrentLaunchesAllReachABusyPrimaryAndNoneKillsIt (fails without the gate: two of four requests lost). Live handoff and Windows unverified. Missing: Explorer associations (installer) and WPF named-event interop.

shell-clickthrough-overlaysConditioningControlPanel/Services/Notifications/OverlayService.cs; ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Compositor/LayeredCompositorHost.cs; ConditioningControlPanel/Overlays/CCP.Avalonia/Platform/X11Overlay.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/PinkFilterOverlay.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/TintOverlayWindow.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Chaos/ChaosOverlayWindow.axaml.cs; CCP.Avalonia/X11OverlayProbe.cs; CCP.Avalonia/OverlayCheck.csstubMechanism (docs/avalonia-decisions.html, desktop overlays): X11 backend pinned on Linux (Program.BuildAvaloniaApp UseX11(); Wayland sessions run via XWayland), non-focus overlay = override-redirect ARGB window + empty XFixes input region, both set before Show() (X11Overlay.SetOverrideRedirect(window, bounds), which sets override-redirect before any geometry so the WM cannot replay a stale size after map, + SetClickThrough). --overlay-check reads back per screen from the X server: XID exists and is unmapped before Show, then map_state=IsViewable, override_redirect=True, depth 32, 0 input rects, geometry == Screens bounds; 25/25 consecutive PASS live on this box (XDG_SESSION_TYPE=wayland, 3 screens; overlay-check-loop-25.txt) and in nested kwin; fails (exit 1) with override-redirect skipped. --x11-probe covers click-through toggle + restack. Evidence ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/x11-override-redirect/. Flash images now open overlays through this (feat-flash; X11Overlay.SetOpacity added: compositor-side alpha, because re-rendering the overlays each fade frame on GLX/XWayland stalled the UI dispatcher ~1.7 s per burst). Windows (win32-overlay-shim): the same entry points route an "HWND" handle to CCP.Avalonia/Platform/Win32Overlay.cs (WS_EX_LAYERED|TOOLWINDOW + WS_EX_TRANSPARENT|NOACTIVATE toggled together, kept through Avalonia's style rebuilds via Win32Properties.AddWindowStylesCallback, HWND_TOPMOST, LWA_ALPHA opacity; WPF bits from OverlayService.cs:1415, FlashService.cs:4614/:4838); dispatch covered by Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/OverlayBackendDispatchTests.cs; compiled for win-x64 only, never run here - verified only by the windows CI --overlay-check step (user32 read-back, SKIP without a desktop session). RestackAbove has no Win32 half. Risk: SetOverrideRedirect sizes by DesktopScaling, which on mixed-DPI Windows comes from the monitor the window was created on, so an overlay on a different-DPI screen may be mis-sized (the CI check has one screen). Still stub: tutorial spotlight hole/rect input remains unavailable.

win-launcherConditioningControlPanel/Windows/Launcher/LauncherWindow.xaml, LauncherWindow*.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/LauncherWindow.axaml.cs, LauncherWindow.Depth.cs, LauncherWindow.Fx.csstub Historical evidence retained verbatim from the base; appended lane and review evidence follows. Earlier base evidence 1: Shell: title bar (wordmark, minimize, close), panel card (banner, eyebrow, title, blurb, Launch CTA), games grid seated by Core LauncherGridLayout, cards from Core LauncherCards with WPF's rim, fade, pills (Sign in to play / Prime / NEW) and Play/Locked/Sign in button; only destinations this head has are drawn (Graded Intake -> panel on the tab; signed-out opens the login dialog owned by the launcher). Every game card hidden until its host exists (docs/avalonia-decisions.html); the Breakout demo's host exists (games-host). Account row + panel card (launcher-account): sign-in pill (signed out) / account chip (initial, name, Patreon tier badge with hover popup, SP chip) opening App Settings; mod pill (Mod: <name>, menu in Core LauncherModMenu order with the active one ticked + Manage mods -> panel Mod Manager; a pick goes through the panel's SwitchActiveModFromLauncher); CoreMods.ModChanged repaints the pill and redraws the tiles via Core LauncherTileRefresh; panel card status (Not running / Running since HH:mm from CoreEngine.StartedUtc, Stop link -> StopEngine, CTA Launch/Open), Level / Sparkle Points / Time under and XP bar + caption on a 1 s tick. LauncherWindowTests.AccountChip_*, PanelCard_*, ModPill_* fail-proven; live sandbox text ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-account/win-launcher.txt (pill, Mod: CCP Default, 4 / 42 / 1h 35m / 120 / 865 XP, 0 binding errors; mod menu not opened live: the window reports Minimized on this desktop). FX (launcher-fx, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs): WPF's backdrop (radial base, two turning spirals at 10 fps, glow + pool + vignette, AmbientFxCanvas fog/dust/aurora), hover lift 1.02 + tilt toward the pointer + tile DropShadow glow 0.35->0.7 + the hue bleeding into the backdrop glow, the Play/CTA exit beat (pop, two shockwave rings, burst + echo, the rest dims to 0.55, decaying shake; the hide held FadeLeadMs then a 220 ms fade-out), a locked/signed-out flinch, welcome-back bursts, edge flare/breath/glint (open, focus back every >=4 s, idle 14 s), a 260 ms fade-in, and the cues (open, click on every button, hover melody via Core LauncherMelody (git mv), denied, launch, edge, return) through CoreAudio, gated on LauncherSoundEnabled and master volume. One frame clock steps it all, only while shown and not minimised and only while something moves; motion Off/Reduced/Performance gate it as WPF does. LauncherFxTests (10, stepped clock incl. real-pointer hover and the hover throttle on an injected TimeProvider; each fail-proven, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-fx/fail-proofs.txt); spirals park on Deactivated; off-screen Play (game boot, handoff) is silent; a fade guard timer forces the hide; a close drops a pending exit. Not run live (port 3001 contention). Missing: cursor parallax, Ken-Burns art drift, the tile-art slide against the tilt, art HoverPop, the locked-tile tier rim (TierFxBorder), sparkle trail + stars, perimeter comets (tile, running panel card + rim breath), CTA/wandering/wordmark sheens, wordmark drift, running-dot breath, hover title tint, embers layer (no Avalonia layer), three-voice hover cap and output-suppressed probe (CoreAudio returns no handle), odometer/bar tweens and the tier badge wobble, GrantsChanged redraw (no grant service here), gear/media dialog, shortcuts, friends chip/What's new, mystery card. Skip-to-panel box (launcher-boot): bottom-right, shows and saves LauncherSkipToPanel (WPF SkipToPanel_Click; the click cue comes from the window-wide Button.Click handler, a CheckBox being a Button here); LauncherWindowTests.SkipToPanelBox_ShowsAndSavesTheSetting fail-proven; live toggle saved true and the next boot opened the panel (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-boot/win-launcher-boot-bare.png, win-launcher-handoff.txt). render-all; Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LauncherWindowTests.cs; ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/launcher-core/win-launcher-live.png. Lockdown veil (lockdown-veil, LauncherWindow.Veil.cs): WPF's #D9070310 veil over every row with launcher_lockdown_veil (9 languages, Core), toggled by LockdownActivated/Deactivated, red vignette + text breath (3 s, sine, auto-reverse) on a 30 fps tick that runs only while the veil and the launcher are shown and ambient loops are allowed; keys are swallowed at the window (tunnel) so Tab/Enter/Space reach nothing veiled (WPF leaves focus alone) and focus moves to the veil. LockdownVeilTests.LauncherVeil_FollowsLockdown_SwallowsClicksAndKeys_BreathesOnlyWhileShown fail-proven (veil toggle, key swallow, hit test, hidden-launcher tick); not run live (the veil only shows when something other than the panel starts a Lockdown while the launcher is up). Belt and braces kept: StopLink_Click calls MainShellWindow.RefuseStopUnderLockdown() and ModPill_Click/SwitchMod refuse while LockdownActive (tests Lockdown_StopLinkRefuses_EngineKeepsRunning, Lockdown_ModPillOpensNoMenu_AndSwitchModRefuses; 1 s timer stop on hide: StatusTimer_StopsWhenTheLauncherHides). Games (games-host, trunk Views/Games base): the shared game host CCP.Avalonia/Views/Games/GameWindow.cs (WPF per-game WebView2 hosts over Chaos/ChaosWebViewHost.cs: one window per game, focused not relaunched, page off WebAssetServer, ready -> init, a station's media-request -> a local library deal of .gif/.webp (WPF BackRoomBridge.cs:208 / BackRoomMedia local source; GameMediaManifest.cs, the DtrhAssetManifest local walk), exit/exit-done/close/boot-error close it, panic surface "games" = WPF GameSurfaces.cs:53-55). Assets/web/backroom/bridge.js now also speaks the Avalonia string carrier (invokeCSharpAction out, __ccpRnPush in, as intake/web-shim.js), so Back Room pages are hosted on WebKitGTK. Piece by Piece (feat-pbp-host) and Racing Thoughts (game-race, behind RacingAccess) are registered too. Of the Back Room games only the Breakout demo is registered (WPF BreakoutHostService.cs:8,13: free, no account; URL carries demo=1 so access.js holds 3 levels): its tile now shows, Play runs the leash check first, opens the host, hides the launcher after the exit beat and brings it back on close when the panel is not up (LauncherHost.cs:335); companion 'game.breakoutdemo' goes through the same Play. Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/GameWindowTests.cs (Play opens + panic closes, leash gate, page frames through WebHost.OnWebMessage incl. the origin guard, demo=1, media deal: each fail-proven; library walk asserted) and node Assets/web/backroom/stations/breakout/bridge-carrier.test.js (fail-proven against the old bridge.js; CI runs no node tests). Live: tile Play opened the GameWindow (~/ccp-port/evidence/games-host/live.txt); page boot not visible in the capture. Missing: the host fx primitives (every fx id but the five big beats page-fx.js draws is acked skipped 'unknown', WPF BackRoomBridge.OnFx), media deal's online/mixed sources, animation header probe and words, the rest of BuildInit (lex, audio, motion, gates), Escape/fullscreen/heartbeat, and the other games (Back Room, Breakout full, DtRH, Arcademy, Goon); their tiles stay hidden and there is no mystery card. Tile Play, the signed-out card press, the sign-in pill, the panel CTA and the account chip refuse under Lockdown in place of WPF's veil (Lockdown_TilePlayRefuses_LauncherStaysAndPanelStaysTucked, Lockdown_SignedOutCardPress_AndSignInPillOpenNoLogin (real pointer press), Lockdown_PanelCtaAndAccountChip_LeaveThePanelTucked; each guard fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-games/lockdown-failproofs.txt); the intake test now clicks the real tile button. FX (launcher-fx, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs): WPF's backdrop (radial base, two turning spirals at 10 fps, glow + pool + vignette, AmbientFxCanvas fog/dust/aurora), hover lift 1.02 + tilt toward the pointer + tile DropShadow glow 0.35->0.7 + the hue bleeding into the backdrop glow, the Play/CTA exit beat (pop, two shockwave rings, burst + echo, the rest dims to 0.55, decaying shake; the hide held FadeLeadMs then a 220 ms fade-out), a locked/signed-out flinch, welcome-back bursts, edge flare/breath/glint (open, focus back every >=4 s, idle 14 s), a 260 ms fade-in, and the cues (open, click on every button, hover melody via Core LauncherMelody (git mv), denied, launch, edge, return) through CoreAudio, gated on LauncherSoundEnabled and master volume. One frame clock steps it all, only while shown and not minimised and only while something moves; motion Off/Reduced/Performance gate it as WPF does. LauncherFxTests (10, stepped clock incl. real-pointer hover and the hover throttle on an injected TimeProvider; each fail-proven, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-fx/fail-proofs.txt); spirals park on Deactivated; off-screen Play (game boot, handoff) is silent; a fade guard timer forces the hide; a close drops a pending exit. Not run live (port 3001 contention). Missing: cursor parallax, Ken-Burns art drift, the tile-art slide against the tilt, art HoverPop, the locked-tile tier rim (TierFxBorder), sparkle trail + stars, perimeter comets (tile, running panel card + rim breath), CTA/wandering/wordmark sheens, wordmark drift, running-dot breath, hover title tint, embers layer (no Avalonia layer), three-voice hover cap and output-suppressed probe (CoreAudio returns no handle), odometer/bar tweens and the tier badge wobble, GrantsChanged redraw (no grant service here), friends chip/What's new, mystery card. Media pill, shortcut link + tile shortcut button (.desktop on Linux, .lnk on Windows, compile-only): mine-launcher-links (LauncherLinksTests, live ~/ccp-port/evidence/mine-launcher-links/). Skip-to-panel box (launcher-boot): bottom-right, shows and saves LauncherSkipToPanel (WPF SkipToPanel_Click; the click cue comes from the window-wide Button.Click handler, a CheckBox being a Button here); LauncherWindowTests.SkipToPanelBox_ShowsAndSavesTheSetting fail-proven; live toggle saved true and the next boot opened the panel (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-boot/win-launcher-boot-bare.png, win-launcher-handoff.txt). render-all; Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LauncherWindowTests.cs; ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/launcher-core/win-launcher-live.png. Lockdown veil (lockdown-veil, LauncherWindow.Veil.cs): WPF's #D9070310 veil over every row with launcher_lockdown_veil (9 languages, Core), toggled by LockdownActivated/Deactivated, red vignette + text breath (3 s, sine, auto-reverse) on a 30 fps tick that runs only while the veil and the launcher are shown and ambient loops are allowed; keys are swallowed at the window (tunnel) so Tab/Enter/Space reach nothing veiled (WPF leaves focus alone) and focus moves to the veil. LockdownVeilTests.LauncherVeil_FollowsLockdown_SwallowsClicksAndKeys_BreathesOnlyWhileShown fail-proven (veil toggle, key swallow, hit test, hidden-launcher tick); not run live (the veil only shows when something other than the panel starts a Lockdown while the launcher is up). Belt and braces kept: StopLink_Click calls MainShellWindow.RefuseStopUnderLockdown() and ModPill_Click/SwitchMod refuse while LockdownActive (tests Lockdown_StopLinkRefuses_EngineKeepsRunning, Lockdown_ModPillOpensNoMenu_AndSwitchModRefuses; 1 s timer stop on hide: StatusTimer_StopsWhenTheLauncherHides). Games (games-host, trunk Views/Games base): the shared game host CCP.Avalonia/Views/Games/GameWindow.cs (WPF per-game WebView2 hosts over Chaos/ChaosWebViewHost.cs: one window per game, focused not relaunched, page off WebAssetServer, ready -> init, a station's media-request -> a local library deal of .gif/.webp (WPF BackRoomBridge.cs:208 / BackRoomMedia local source; GameMediaManifest.cs, the DtrhAssetManifest local walk), exit/exit-done/close/boot-error close it, panic surface "games" = WPF GameSurfaces.cs:53-55). Assets/web/backroom/bridge.js now also speaks the Avalonia string carrier (invokeCSharpAction out, __ccpRnPush in, as intake/web-shim.js), so Back Room pages are hosted on WebKitGTK. Piece by Piece (feat-pbp-host) and Racing Thoughts (game-race, behind RacingAccess) are registered too. Of the Back Room games only the Breakout demo is registered (WPF BreakoutHostService.cs:8,13: free, no account; URL carries demo=1 so access.js holds 3 levels): its tile now shows, Play runs the leash check first, opens the host, hides the launcher after the exit beat and brings it back on close when the panel is not up (LauncherHost.cs:335); companion 'game.breakoutdemo' goes through the same Play. Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/GameWindowTests.cs (Play opens + panic closes, leash gate, page frames through WebHost.OnWebMessage incl. the origin guard, demo=1, media deal: each fail-proven; library walk asserted) and node Assets/web/backroom/stations/breakout/bridge-carrier.test.js (fail-proven against the old bridge.js; CI runs no node tests). Live: tile Play opened the GameWindow (~/ccp-port/evidence/games-host/live.txt); page boot not visible in the capture. Missing: the host fx primitives (every fx id but the five big beats page-fx.js draws is acked skipped 'unknown', WPF BackRoomBridge.OnFx), media deal's online/mixed sources, animation header probe and words, the rest of BuildInit (lex, audio, motion, gates), Escape/fullscreen/heartbeat, and the other games (Back Room, Breakout full, DtRH, Arcademy, Goon); their tiles stay hidden and there is no mystery card. Tile Play, the signed-out card press, the sign-in pill, the panel CTA and the account chip refuse under Lockdown in place of WPF's veil (Lockdown_TilePlayRefuses_LauncherStaysAndPanelStaysTucked, Lockdown_SignedOutCardPress_AndSignInPillOpenNoLogin (real pointer press), Lockdown_PanelCtaAndAccountChip_LeaveThePanelTucked; each guard fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-games/lockdown-failproofs.txt); the intake test now clicks the real tile button. Main-sync folds (port-social): 239c1ae6e Lobby chip with a dropdown of open tables (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs, OpenTables) and the 53b81238c launcher look; needs the Lobby service (see views-tab-available-subjects). Its 7.1.5 look (d0001dd5e): Sky chip, dimmed once seen, opening the drop marks Social seen (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs LobbyChipOpacity). Whole-card launch + once-per-window grow to seat every tile row (sync6-launcher-badges): LauncherWindowTests.WholeCard_*, OverflowingTiles_* fail-proven (~/ccp-port/evidence/sync6-launcher-badges/fail-proofs.txt); grow not run live (Wayland ignores Position; one tile never overflows here). Speaker (rows-launcher, LauncherWindow.Sound.cs, WPF LauncherWindow.Sound.cs + xaml:452-464): title-bar cone/waves/slash toggles and saves LauncherSoundEnabled, dims the cone to 0.45, bound mute/unmute tooltip (Core strings, 9 languages); muting is silent, unmuting answers with one click (window-wide click cue runs after the handler). LauncherFxTests.SpeakerButton_ByRealClick_MutesQuietly_UnmutesWithANote (real pointer press; fail-proven twice: slash not repainted, toggle removed; ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher-failproof.txt); live sandbox invoke -> slash shown, settings false, invoke -> true, 0 binding errors (~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-speaker.txt); render ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-render.png. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; LeashHead seeds both (leash-gate-card), and the panel shows the gate card (see feat-leash). LauncherFxTests.Play_UnderALeashPunishment_GoesToTheGate fail-proven (leashBlocks forced false -> red). Additional source evidence: Shell: title bar (wordmark, minimize, close), panel card (banner, eyebrow, title, blurb, Launch CTA), games grid seated by Core LauncherGridLayout, cards from Core LauncherCards with WPF's rim, fade, pills (Sign in to play / Prime / NEW) and Play/Locked/Sign in button; only destinations this head has are drawn (Graded Intake -> panel on the tab; signed-out opens the login dialog owned by the launcher). LauncherFxTests.SpeakerButton_ByRealClick_MutesQuietly_UnmutesWithANote (real pointer press; fail-proven twice: slash not repainted, toggle removed; ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher-failproof.txt); live sandbox invoke -> slash shown, settings false, invoke -> true, 0 binding errors (~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-speaker.txt); render ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-render.png. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; LeashHead seeds both (leash-gate-card), and the panel shows the gate card (see feat-leash). LauncherFxTests.Play_UnderALeashPunishment_GoesToTheGate fail-proven (leashBlocks forced false -> red). Additional evidence: Shell: title bar (wordmark, minimize, close), panel card (banner, eyebrow, title, blurb, Launch CTA), games grid seated by Core LauncherGridLayout, cards from Core LauncherCards with WPF's rim, fade, pills (Sign in to play / Prime / NEW) and Play/Locked/Sign in button; only destinations this head has are drawn (Graded Intake -> panel on the tab; signed-out opens the login dialog owned by the launcher). Every game card hidden until its host exists (docs/avalonia-decisions.html). Account row + panel card (launcher-account): sign-in pill (signed out) / account chip (initial, name, Patreon tier badge with hover popup, SP chip) opening App Settings; mod pill (Mod: <name>, menu in Core LauncherModMenu order with the active one ticked + Manage mods -> panel Mod Manager; a pick goes through the panel's SwitchActiveModFromLauncher); CoreMods.ModChanged repaints the pill and redraws the tiles via Core LauncherTileRefresh; panel card status (Not running / Running since HH:mm from CoreEngine.StartedUtc, Stop link -> StopEngine, CTA Launch/Open), Level / Sparkle Points / Time under and XP bar + caption on a 1 s tick. LauncherWindowTests.AccountChip_*, PanelCard_*, ModPill_* fail-proven; live sandbox text ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-account/win-launcher.txt (pill, Mod: CCP Default, 4 / 42 / 1h 35m / 120 / 865 XP, 0 binding errors; mod menu not opened live: the window reports Minimized on this desktop). FX (launcher-fx, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs): WPF's backdrop (radial base, two turning spirals at 10 fps, glow + pool + vignette, AmbientFxCanvas fog/dust/aurora), hover lift 1.02 + tilt toward the pointer + tile DropShadow glow 0.35->0.7 + the hue bleeding into the backdrop glow, the Play/CTA exit beat (pop, two shockwave rings, burst + echo, the rest dims to 0.55, decaying shake; the hide held FadeLeadMs then a 220 ms fade-out), a locked/signed-out flinch, welcome-back bursts, edge flare/breath/glint (open, focus back every >=4 s, idle 14 s), a 260 ms fade-in, and the cues (open, click on every button, hover melody via Core LauncherMelody (git mv), denied, launch, edge, return) through CoreAudio, gated on LauncherSoundEnabled and master volume. One frame clock steps it all, only while shown and not minimised and only while something moves; motion Off/Reduced/Performance gate it as WPF does. LauncherFxTests (10, stepped clock incl. real-pointer hover and the hover throttle on an injected TimeProvider; each fail-proven, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-fx/fail-proofs.txt); spirals park on Deactivated; off-screen Play (game boot, handoff) is silent; a fade guard timer forces the hide; a close drops a pending exit. Assets/web/backroom/bridge.js now also speaks the Avalonia string carrier (invokeCSharpAction out, __ccpRnPush in, as intake/web-shim.js), so Back Room pages are hosted on WebKitGTK. Piece by Piece (feat-pbp-host) and Racing Thoughts (game-race, behind RacingAccess) are registered too. Of the Back Room games only the Breakout demo is registered (WPF BreakoutHostService.cs:8,13: free, no account; URL carries demo=1 so access.js holds 3 levels): its tile now shows, Play runs the leash check first, opens the host, hides the launcher after the exit beat and brings it back on close when the panel is not up (LauncherHost.cs:335); companion 'game.breakoutdemo' goes through the same Play. LauncherFxTests (10, stepped clock incl. real-pointer hover and the hover throttle on an injected TimeProvider; each fail-proven, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-fx/fail-proofs.txt); spirals park on Deactivated; off-screen Play (game boot, handoff) is silent; a fade guard timer forces the hide; a close drops a pending exit. Not run live (port 3001 contention). Missing: cursor parallax, Ken-Burns art drift, the tile-art slide against the tilt, art HoverPop, the locked-tile tier rim (TierFxBorder), sparkle trail + stars, perimeter comets (tile, running panel card + rim breath), CTA/wandering/wordmark sheens, wordmark drift, running-dot breath, hover title tint, embers layer (no Avalonia layer), three-voice hover cap and output-suppressed probe (CoreAudio returns no handle), odometer/bar tweens and the tier badge wobble, GrantsChanged redraw (no grant service here), friends chip/What's new, mystery card. Skip-to-panel box (launcher-boot): bottom-right, shows and saves LauncherSkipToPanel (WPF SkipToPanel_Click; the click cue comes from the window-wide Button.Click handler, a CheckBox being a Button here); LauncherWindowTests.SkipToPanelBox_ShowsAndSavesTheSetting fail-proven; live toggle saved true and the next boot opened the panel (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port-launcher-boot/win-launcher-boot-bare.png, win-launcher-handoff.txt). render-all; Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LauncherWindowTests.cs; ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/launcher-core/win-launcher-live.png. Lockdown veil (lockdown-veil, LauncherWindow.Veil.cs): WPF's #D9070310 veil over every row with launcher_lockdown_veil (9 languages, Core), toggled by LockdownActivated/Deactivated, red vignette + text breath (3 s, sine, auto-reverse) on a 30 fps tick that runs only while the veil and the launcher are shown and ambient loops are allowed; keys are swallowed at the window (tunnel) so Tab/Enter/Space reach nothing veiled (WPF leaves focus alone) and focus moves to the veil. LockdownVeilTests.LauncherVeil_FollowsLockdown_SwallowsClicksAndKeys_BreathesOnlyWhileShown fail-proven (veil toggle, key swallow, hit test, hidden-launcher tick); not run live (the veil only shows when something other than the panel starts a Lockdown while the launcher is up). Belt and braces kept: StopLink_Click calls MainShellWindow.RefuseStopUnderLockdown() and ModPill_Click/SwitchMod refuse while LockdownActive (tests Lockdown_StopLinkRefuses_EngineKeepsRunning, Lockdown_ModPillOpensNoMenu_AndSwitchModRefuses; 1 s timer stop on hide: StatusTimer_StopsWhenTheLauncherHides). Games (games-host, trunk Views/Games base): the shared game host CCP.Avalonia/Views/Games/GameWindow.cs (WPF per-game WebView2 hosts over Chaos/ChaosWebViewHost.cs: one window per game, focused not relaunched, page off WebAssetServer, ready -> init, a station's media-request -> a local library deal of .gif/.webp (WPF BackRoomBridge.cs:208 / BackRoomMedia local source; GameMediaManifest.cs, the DtrhAssetManifest local walk), exit/exit-done/close/boot-error close it, panic surface "games" = WPF GameSurfaces.cs:53-55). Assets/web/backroom/bridge.js now also speaks the Avalonia string carrier (invokeCSharpAction out, __ccpRnPush in, as intake/web-shim.js), so Back Room pages are hosted on WebKitGTK. Piece by Piece (feat-pbp-host) and Racing Thoughts (game-race, behind RacingAccess) are registered too. Of the Back Room games only the Breakout demo is registered (WPF BreakoutHostService.cs:8,13: free, no account; URL carries demo=1 so access.js holds 3 levels): its tile now shows, Play runs the leash check first, opens the host, hides the launcher after the exit beat and brings it back on close when the panel is not up (LauncherHost.cs:335); companion 'game.breakoutdemo' goes through the same Play. Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/GameWindowTests.cs (Play opens + panic closes, leash gate, page frames through WebHost.OnWebMessage incl. the origin guard, demo=1, media deal: each fail-proven; library walk asserted) and node Assets/web/backroom/stations/breakout/bridge-carrier.test.js (fail-proven against the old bridge.js; CI runs no node tests). Live: tile Play opened the GameWindow (~/ccp-port/evidence/games-host/live.txt); page boot not visible in the capture. Missing: the host fx primitives (every fx id but the five big beats page-fx.js draws is acked skipped 'unknown', WPF BackRoomBridge.OnFx), media deal's online/mixed sources, animation header probe and words, the rest of BuildInit (lex, audio, motion, gates), Escape/fullscreen/heartbeat, and the other games (Back Room, Breakout full, DtRH, Arcademy, Goon); their tiles stay hidden and there is no mystery card. Tile Play, the signed-out card press, the sign-in pill, the panel CTA and the account chip refuse under Lockdown in place of WPF's veil (Lockdown_TilePlayRefuses_LauncherStaysAndPanelStaysTucked, Lockdown_SignedOutCardPress_AndSignInPillOpenNoLogin (real pointer press), Lockdown_PanelCtaAndAccountChip_LeaveThePanelTucked; each guard fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/launcher-games/lockdown-failproofs.txt); the intake test now clicks the real tile button. Main-sync folds (port-social): 239c1ae6e Lobby chip with a dropdown of open tables (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs, OpenTables) and the 53b81238c launcher look; needs the Lobby service (see views-tab-available-subjects). Its 7.1.5 look (d0001dd5e): Sky chip, dimmed once seen, opening the drop marks Social seen (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs LobbyChipOpacity). Whole-card launch + once-per-window grow to seat every tile row (sync6-launcher-badges): LauncherWindowTests.WholeCard_*, OverflowingTiles_* fail-proven (~/ccp-port/evidence/sync6-launcher-badges/fail-proofs.txt); grow not run live (Wayland ignores Position; one tile never overflows here). Speaker (rows-launcher, LauncherWindow.Sound.cs, WPF LauncherWindow.Sound.cs + xaml:452-464): title-bar cone/waves/slash toggles and saves LauncherSoundEnabled, dims the cone to 0.45, bound mute/unmute tooltip (Core strings, 9 languages); muting is silent, unmuting answers with one click (window-wide click cue runs after the handler). LauncherFxTests.SpeakerButton_ByRealClick_MutesQuietly_UnmutesWithANote (real pointer press; fail-proven twice: slash not repainted, toggle removed; ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher-failproof.txt); live sandbox invoke -> slash shown, settings false, invoke -> true, 0 binding errors (~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-speaker.txt); render ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-launcher/win-launcher-render.png. Leash gate before play (mine-launcher-account, WPF LauncherHost.cs:360-366, MainWindow.Leash.cs:95-108): Play asks MainShellWindow.LeashBlocksGames and a pending punishment opens the panel with PresentLeashGateFromLauncher instead of the tab; LeashHead seeds both (leash-gate-card), and the panel shows the gate card (see feat-leash). LauncherFxTests.Play_UnderALeashPunishment_GoesToTheGate fail-proven (leashBlocks forced false -> red). Merged duplicate row also said: Every game card hidden until its host exists (docs/avalonia-decisions.html). Media pill, shortcut link + tile shortcut button (.desktop on Linux, .lnk on Windows, compile-only): mine-launcher-links (LauncherLinksTests, live ~/ccp-port/evidence/mine-launcher-links/). Missing (also absent from old fin4): art-less radial/road fallback, immediate engine-stop refresh, animated tier rims, sparkle trail/stars/embers, perimeter comets/rim breath, wordmark sheen, running-dot breath, odometer/XP tweens, tier badge wobble/popup pop, audio hover voice cap/output suppression, friends/What's New/Lobby chips/open-table badges, mystery cards and remaining game destinations/handoffs. Remaining WPF references: LauncherWindow.Tiles.cs:328,374, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:34,110,411, LauncherWindow.Choreo.cs:398,619, LauncherWindow.TierBadge.cs:14, LauncherWindow.xaml.cs:427,626,659, LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs:44, ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Launcher/LauncherSfx.cs:28; current gaps LauncherWindow.axaml.cs:323,373,382,646, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:7. Old fin4 evidence: a49ad70b4fc0 LauncherWindow.Depth.cs:39,83,105, LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:376,423,434,464, LauncherWindow.axaml.cs:418,558,639, PrizeOwnership.cs:49, HoverPop.cs:160. Validation: Core 4635 passed, 6 existing skips; affected Avalonia selection including TestIsolationTests 182 passed, 0 skipped; all three builds, Core guards and docs self-check passed. Headless only, no live desktop or Windows-native run. No new strings or WPF/Core changes. No part B. Appended second-gate review correction (2026-10-31): status stub because the missing WPF behaviors listed above remain. Logo-only drift in a clipped wordmark host (LauncherWindow.axaml:215, LauncherWindow.Depth.cs:39; WPF LauncherWindow.xaml:357-365 and LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:411-439). Visible deactivation resets the logo and eases parallax home over 260 ms, quadratic out (LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:327, LauncherWindow.Depth.cs:61; WPF LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:192-212, LauncherWindow.Backdrop.cs:67-77,246-275). Hide, minimize, close, motion Off and Performance keep their immediate snap. Tests strengthen WordmarkDrift_HasFortySecondLeg_AndResetsWhenHidden and PointerDepth_FollowsWpfDistances_AndSettlesOnLeave; add focus-return gate and hard-park regressions. Reveal-snapshot comment corrected (LauncherWindow.axaml.cs:70). Earlier status and validation claims describe their recorded revisions; this review status is authoritative. Residual risks remain: tile glow not inspected live, grant subscribers can throw, sign-out has no grant-clear feed, headless-only validation. Review validation (2026-10-31): Release build passed with 0 errors; Core 4636 passed, 5 existing microphone skips; LauncherFxTests plus TestIsolationTests and AmbientBeatLoopsTests 52 passed, 0 skipped. Reverting logo target and deactivation easing produced 2 focused assertion failures; removing the logo clip produced 1 focused assertion failure; all mutations restored before the green run. Core guards and docs self-check passed. Focused regressions: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/LauncherFxTests.cs:184,228,251,346. No finding rejected. No live desktop validation. Ported 2026-11-05 (lane windows, merges #3375 #3627): cursor depth and wordmark drift (LauncherWindow.Depth.cs), grant refresh (PrizeOwnership snapshot changes raise PrizeGrants.GrantsChanged), stats and badge motion, the tier rim on locked tiles (frame clock, no Effect), the friends drawer's launcher routes and the launcher-notes / launcher-friends panic rows. Still missing: sparkle trail, wordmark sheen, running-dot breath, embers layer. Embers slice: launcher ambient config includes Embers (CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:189; WPF LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:258). LauncherFxTests.Ambient_IncludesEmbers fails with the flag removed. Part B: cursor trail (WPF LauncherWindow.Fx.cs:311), wordmark sheen (WPF LauncherWindow.Choreo.cs:510), and upper-case section eyebrows (WPF LauncherWindow.xaml.cs:80) remain missing. Appended launcher entrance slice: tiles stagger on every show, with motion Off instant, and Play and panel CTA press squish (LauncherWindow.Entrance.cs:19,42,57; LauncherWindow.axaml.cs:99,110,306,735). Title bar double press toggles maximise. WPF: LauncherWindow.xaml.cs:96,113,190,526, LauncherWindow.Tiles.cs:208, LauncherWindow.xaml:559, MotionFx.cs:89,106. Still missing: sparkle trail, wordmark sheen and embers, among the gaps recorded above. Tests: LauncherEntranceTests.cs. Review fix: mod and changed grant rebuilds and sign-in return restart the tile entrance (LauncherWindow.axaml.cs:479,600; WPF LauncherWindow.xaml.cs:294,380). A press on the maximised title bar restores the window centred under the pointer before dragging (LauncherWindow.axaml.cs:306; WPF LauncherWindow.xaml.cs:190). Tests: LauncherEntranceTests.cs. Restack b73 (#4801): tile entrance, press squish and title-bar double press landed; review fix: under Gentle visuals the entrance fade lengthens to the 300 ms rise floor (GentleVisuals.RiseMs). Restack b19 (#4783): Launcher lobby dropdown lists tables and opens the lobby page with a polling lease; chess, race and Remote join routes exist; a Remote claim in flight is cancelled on panic or Lockdown and its late session url is not opened. The dropdown has a glass shell, card hover lift and Join button travel. Race discovery, the Social badge and its seen state belong to row6-feat-friends-open-tables--launcher-lobby-chip (#4279). Missing: Goon join (WPF joins through GoonHostService.Launch, ConditioningControlPanel/Windows/Launcher/LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs:264, a host this head lacks) and full dropdown styling. Restack b19 review: the launcher Remote claim uses the Subjects page client (CCP.Core/Services/Lobby/RemoteDirectoryClaimClient.cs, honest user agent and merged-account recovery) instead of a second RemoteLobbyApi claim; panic also closes the lobby drop (LauncherWindow.Lobby.cs CancelLobbyClaimForPanic). Restack b80: #4279 (launcher lobby chip) was not landed; it needs a re-cut onto #4783. Race discovery is already live (AvailableSubjectsTabView.BuildLobby passes RaceOpenApi). Still missing from #4279: one Lobby feed shared by the page and the chip (WPF App.Lobby; each builds its own LobbyPoll today), snapshot ownership per account (a switched account never paints the last account's rows), RemoteLobbyApi last-good rows reset per caller, and the Social badge with its seen dimming.
win-layered-audioConditioningControlPanel/Windows/LayeredAudioWindow.xaml, LayeredAudioWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/LayeredAudioWindow.axaml, LayeredAudioWindow.axaml.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Platform/LayeredAudio.csverifiedOpens single-instance from Settings > Audio (BtnAudioLayers) and the Home dashboard button; drives Platform/LayeredAudio.cs (WPF LayeredAudioService rules, one looping LibVLC player per track, cubic-mapped linear gain, cooperative duck from LibVlcAudio.Duck/Unduck). Not ported: WPF's EnsureOnScreen clamp, audio-only session start (no session engine on this head), output-device choice (see shell-audio-playback-devices). Snapshot lock: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Snapshot.Tests/Snapshots/win-layered-audio.verified.png. win-lock-cardConditioningControlPanel/Windows/LockCardWindow.xaml, LockCardWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/LockCardWindow.axaml, LockCardWindow.axaml.cswiredTyped solve at WPF parity: answers go through Core LockCardText (ellipsis/curly quotes/dashes/NBSP/invisibles folded; LockCardTextTests moved to Core), session phrase unbound from its loc key, Deactivated focus reclaim, 52x52 lock glyph, each card sized to its screen (KWin will not maximize a CanResize=False window, so the live card was a clipped 300x200 box), and the success pulse/shake now actually run (they threw before, so a correct repeat never registered). LockCardTypingTests; Keincheck live run: Test button, 3 typed repeats, card completed and closed, binding errors 0 (kc cannot capture the card window, so the picture is ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/lockcard-typed-parity/lockcard-render.png from --render-view). Strict Esc honours the X11 panic listener (PanicKeyTests). Voice solve (lockcard-voice): WPF :338-342 gate (requested + CoreSpeech.IsAvailable + MicConsentGiven), :956-1089 listen loop on the Core SpeechEngine, DisableVoiceForAll filled; LockCardVoiceTests (WAV-fed: spoken phrase completes, wrong phrase stays open, 6 unavailable -> typing), panel frames in ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/lockcard-voice/; no live voice run (kc cannot capture the card, and a live card would open the real default mic). No-model hint names the Linux folder (UserData/Models/vosk), no-consent and close-mid-listen privacy tests. Mic hand-off: an armed wake/PTT loop is stood down for the card and re-armed after (voice-commands). Placement (fix-lockcard-multimon, 2026-10-31): every card gets its screen's Bounds (pixels) and Bounds/Scaling (DIPs) BEFORE Show; moving a mapped card let KWin clamp it, so a 1440x2560@1.3 + 2496x1404 primary desk left the primary card at y=178 instead of 480 and its bottom 302 px usable. Live after: 1440x2560+0+0 and 2496x1404+1440+480, a click at the primary's bottom lands on the card (LockCardMultiMonitorTests; ~/ccp-port/evidence/lockcard-multimon-20261031/). Lock cards always cover every screen, including with DualMonitorEnabled off (WPF LockCardWindow.xaml.cs:1705-1717). The per-monitor mixed-scale case is verified headless only, using ClientSize × RenderScaling after RunJobs with simulated backend scale callbacks; it remains unverified live (the live X11 desk reported one scale for both screens). Missing: achievement/NotifyCompleted services, the TypoMade event (WPF LockCardWindow.xaml.cs:763, feeds the Remote Control screen preview; nothing raises it here). Fluent icons (icons-voice): header 🔐, voice-state glyphs (🎤 ✓ 🔊 ✗) and the ✨ completion mirror are Fluent icons (state swaps set IconLabel.Kind; LockCardVoiceTests asserts Kind Dismiss); divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (renders ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-voice/).
linux-package-vosk-modelinstaller/publishpackaging/linux/build-tarball.shwiredThe linux-x64 tarball bundles vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 under Resources/Models/vosk (fetched by .github/scripts/fetch-vosk-model.sh), the first root SpeechEngine.DefaultModelRoots probes. --smoke with CCP_SMOKE_BUNDLED_VOSK=1 requires the model to load (fails NoModelFound when removed from the tarball); passes from the extracted tarball and from /opt after makepkg -si in an archlinux container: ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/linux-package/. CI runs it on ubuntu. Not verified: no Keincheck voice run from an installed package. Restack b29 (#3615): Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/ReleaseEvidenceTests.cs:40 runs the real packaging script with publish and download stubbed, checks model discovery, licence and libvosk, then removes the model and requires null; it supplements the native smoke above. Placement and discovery follow WPF ConditioningControlPanel/ConditioningControlPanel.csproj:704 and Services/Speech/SpeechService.cs:55-59; CCP.Avalonia/Platform/PulseMicSource.cs:34 uses the shared roots.
linux-packageinstaller/publishpackaging/linux/, packaging/aur/PKGBUILDwiredInstalled run (linux-package-wired, 7.1.5): the CI tarball built locally, installed into a temp prefix the AUR way (now written up as the hand install in docs/avalonia-linux-install.html, snippet run verbatim), .desktop Exec resolved via PATH; installed --smoke passes; a real start in a throwaway kwin_wayland --virtual --xwayland (no Xvfb/weston here) reaches the interactive First run wizard, WM_CLASS = app id, and closing it (WM_DELETE_WINDOW) exits 0; packaging/aur/test-local.sh passes; ldd closure inside depends= (~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package-wired/). Performance: installed 749 MiB (tarball 534 MB); splash 0.46 s, first interactive window 5.80 s after launch (one cold-cache-ish run). Not covered: a real makepkg -si/pacman install (no sudo; bwrap-bound /opt instead), a clean-machine depends= proof. Tarball (reproducible tar; LICENSE; share/ with .desktop + StartupWMClass, 128/256px icons, appstream metainfo; app id io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel) built, extracted and smoked locally and in CI (artifact only, never a release). AUR conditioning-control-panel-bin consumes it: makepkg -si + --smoke pass in archlinux:latest; sha256sums is SKIP until a release pins it. Re-verified for 7.0.5 (package-verify): pkgver was stale at 6.11.3 (fixed; smoke-tarball.sh now fails on the mismatch); Docker down on the dev box, so packaging/aur/test-local.sh (host makepkg + bwrap-bound /opt, pacman -T on depends=) runs the installed launcher's --smoke, fail-proven 3 ways; ldd closure of the bundled .so files is inside depends= (~/ccp-port/evidence/package-verify/). In-app (linux-inapp-deps): Core CCP.Core/Services/LinuxDependencies.cs dlopens the table's libraries (webkit2gtk 4.1/4.0, WPE trio, libvlc, libsecret, libX11/libXi) and reads /etc/os-release for the one pacman/apt/dnf command (unknown distro: library list as the fallback); a startup toast with Copy command (App.axaml.cs) and the WebHost panel (+ Copy button) show it. Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/LinuxDependenciesTests.cs per family + fake probe, fail-proven 4 ways. PortalPanicShortcut calls org.freedesktop.host.portal.Registry.Register(io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel) first on its connection; live --portal-check + dbus-monitor: with the .desktop installed (Exec stand-in) Register ok and the impl CreateSession carries our app id, without it refused and filed under org.kde.konsole (~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/linux-inapp-deps/). Not verified: the toast/panel with a library really missing (every library is installed here), physical BindShortcuts under the new id. Not covered: fresh-VM acceptance per channel (manual). linux-package-flatpakinstaller/publishpackaging/flatpak/io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel.ymlwiredBuilt, installed and run for real (2026-10-30, flatpak 1.18.4, flatpak-builder 1.4.9 as org.flatpak.Builder, GNOME Sdk/Platform 50): tarball 7.1.15 from packaging/linux/build-tarball.sh, then flatpak run org.flatpak.Builder --user --install --force-clean --repo=<repo> --state-dir=<state> <build> <manifest> exit 0 after three manifest fixes, each a build failure first: vlc BUILDCC=gcc -std=gnu99 (configure: "Cannot find native C99 compiler"), vlc 3.0.21 -> 3.0.24 (3.0.21 fails on the Sdk FFmpeg: AVCodecContext has no member channels), and the tray own-name: org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-* is rejected at finish ("Invalid dbus name"), so the manifest lists -2-0..-2-3 (the app is pid 2 in the sandbox; n counts TrayIcon instances, and the app makes one. Avalonia 12.1.5 keeps that name across watcher restarts and catches a refused name, so -2-1..-2-3 only cover a failed RequestName retry. The 10-30 build shipped 12.1.2, which took a new name per restart. 2026-11-12: -<pid>-0 held through 5 restarts of a fake watcher on a private bus, dev build, not inside the Flatpak: ~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/flatpak-tray-restart-20261112/). Installed --smoke with CCP_SMOKE_BUNDLED_VOSK=1 passes every check incl. the bundled LibVLC clip and the Vosk model from /app/lib/ccp (exit 0). Real start on the live KDE Plasma Wayland session (app on XWayland :0), throwaway profile via --filesystem=<tmp> --env=CCP_USERDATA_DIR/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME=<tmp> (~/.var/app unchanged but flatpak's own .ld.so cache): splash 0.76 s, shell 5.8 s, interactive First run wizard 6.1 s, WM_CLASS = app id, tray name org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-2-0 owned through the proxy; KWin closeWindow() (WM_DELETE_WINDOW) on the windows exits flatpak run 0 (age gate unaccepted -> clean shutdown). WPE settled: not bundled, as the decision log now says (WebKitGTK default, WPE opt-in via CCP_LINUX_WEBVIEW=wpe with GTK fallback); in the sandbox webkit2gtk-4.1, libgstautodetect, libsecret, libXi resolve, the WPE trio does not, libvlc from /app. Evidence: ~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/flatpak-20261030/. Re-run on port/7.2 (2026-11-04, ca0d0a3b8f, tarball 7.2.1): flatpak-builder fails on the unpatched manifest (no BUILDCC) and passes with these three fixes; install, sandbox --smoke 9/9 (LibVLC clip, Vosk from /app/lib/ccp) and the sandbox library check pass, all headless, no live GUI start that time, so the window path and tray own-names are proven on 7.1.15 only (~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/preview-72-20261104/). Not verified: a web page actually rendering in the Flatpak (behind the age gate), a native-Wayland run (X11 only by design), a watcher restart inside the Flatpak, Keincheck voice, panic key / overlays / portal from the Flatpak on this base, a clean machine, the RT-ENGINE-NOTICES.txt licence install (#3849 landed after the 11-04 run). Missing: the .flatpak bundle on the linux-preview-<version> pre-release (local repo only so far; no preview OSTree repo or .flatpakref, see avalonia-linux-install.html). 2026-11-05 (Linux beta 1, lane linux-race): #3849 adds RT-ENGINE-NOTICES.txt to the licence install and records why Racing Thoughts needs no new grants (network, ipc and dri are already there; Electron is fetched on the first race into the app data dir, never bundled); inside Flatpak the Chromium sandbox falls back to --no-sandbox (packaging/linux/rt-engine-check.sh). Shipping the race engine is blocked on the owner/legal call on Electron's ffmpeg codecs.
win-mantraConditioningControlPanel/Windows/MantraWindow.xaml, MantraWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MantraWindow.axaml, MantraWindow.axaml.cswiredSession half ported (mantra-service): Core CCP.Core/Services/MantraService.cs (git mv) drives the window: typed line -> TryCompleteMantra (XP 30+min(streak5,50), quests, next line, box cleared), idle 5 s breaks the streak (Chaster note), completion overlay + 5 s auto-close, events unsubscribed on close; opened bare (render proof) it starts a MantraDefaultCount session, a deviation (render ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/mantra-service/win-mantra-render.png). Drone + tones via CCP.Avalonia/Platform/ToneWav.cs (LibVLC layer / CoreAudio.PlayOneShot, no NAudio); drone opens muted at WPF's raw 0.05, MantraDroneVolume from the first ramp step; app/tray exit closes the window, disposes the drone and deletes the WAVs (App.StopMantra). rows-mantra-window: all five Storyboards ported as tweens stepped off the float timer on MantraWindow.Clock (pulse 1.06/0.15 s on a line, letter-pulse 1.02/0.08 s on a right letter, wrong-shake 4/-4/3/-3 px on a wrong letter, shake 8/-8/6/-6/3 px on a broken streak, glow 0->0.3 over 2 s reversed forever; WPF xaml:14-58); panic surface mantra (PanicSurfaces, WPF KillAllAudio -> Mantra?.Dispose()) ends the session and also stops the drone WPF left humming; the Programs Mantra-task door (WPF #1230 BtnProgramOpenMantras_Click -> StartMantraSession(reps), ProgramTaskItem.OpenVisible/OpenReps) is in the today-task template. wire-win-mantra: the user path is live since programs-run-3b: the Programs run view builds TodayTaskList and a Mantra task's door (WPF :1149, OpenVisible/OpenReps) opens the window at the task's reps via OpenProgramMantrasAsync -> StartMantraSession (ProgramsRunControlsTests.LoadedRunThisHeadCannotFinishSaysSoAndOpensTheMantraDoor now clicks the door through to the open window, fail-proven by dropping the StartMantraSession call, red output ~/ccp-port/evidence/wire-win-mantra/fail-proofs.txt). Reach is narrower than WPF's: only kept carries Mantra tasks and this head refuses to enroll kept (KeywordTrigger not raised; blocker row shell-programs-tab), so a Linux-only user cannot reach the Mantra Lab door today; it shows only for a kept run loaded from a Windows profile. StartMantraSession's failure MessageBox is ported (WPF's "Mantras" / "Couldn't start the mantra session:\n\n{message}" through MessageDialog; MainShellWindow.NewMantraWindow seam; MantraWindowSessionTests.FailedOpenShowsWpfsWarning, fail-proven by dropping the dialog, same log; wait bounded at 10 s). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MantraWindowSessionTests.cs (StoryboardsStepOnTheClock, PanicStopsTheDroneAndEndsTheSession, ProgramTaskDoorOpensTheMantraLabAtTheTaskReps, FailedOpenShowsWpfsWarning; each fail-proven: 5 storyboard lines, panic StopDrone, door reps; log ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mantra-window/fail-proofs.txt), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/MantraServiceTests.cs (fail-proven x7). No Keincheck run yet; drone/tone not heard live; tween smoothness not measured. Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MantraWindowSessionTests.cs (StoryboardsStepOnTheClock, PanicStopsTheDroneAndEndsTheSession, ProgramTaskDoorOpensTheMantraLabAtTheTaskReps, FailedOpenShowsWpfsWarning; each fail-proven: 5 storyboard lines, panic StopDrone, door reps; log ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mantra-window/fail-proofs.txt), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/MantraServiceTests.cs (fail-proven x7). No Keincheck run yet; drone/tone not heard live; tween smoothness not measured. Earlier merged evidence: Session half ported (mantra-service): Core CCP.Core/Services/MantraService.cs (git mv) drives the window: typed line -> TryCompleteMantra (XP 30+min(streak5,50), quests, next line, box cleared), idle 5 s breaks the streak (Chaster note), completion overlay + 5 s auto-close, events unsubscribed on close; opened bare (render proof) it starts a MantraDefaultCount session, a deviation (render ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/mantra-service/win-mantra-render.png). Drone + tones via CCP.Avalonia/Platform/ToneWav.cs (LibVLC layer / CoreAudio.PlayOneShot, no NAudio); drone opens muted at WPF's raw 0.05, MantraDroneVolume from the first ramp step; app/tray exit closes the window, disposes the drone and deletes the WAVs (App.StopMantra). rows-mantra-window: all five Storyboards ported as tweens stepped off the float timer on MantraWindow.Clock (pulse 1.06/0.15 s on a line, letter-pulse 1.02/0.08 s on a right letter, wrong-shake 4/-4/3/-3 px on a wrong letter, shake 8/-8/6/-6/3 px on a broken streak, glow 0->0.3 over 2 s reversed forever; WPF xaml:14-58); panic surface mantra (PanicSurfaces, WPF KillAllAudio -> Mantra?.Dispose()) ends the session and also stops the drone WPF left humming; the Programs Mantra-task door (WPF #1230 BtnProgramOpenMantras_Click -> StartMantraSession(reps), ProgramTaskItem.OpenVisible/OpenReps) is in the today-task template. Still stub: the door is unreachable because the Avalonia Programs tab never builds TodayTaskList (enrollment/today layer unported), so nothing a user clicks opens the window; StartMantraSession's WPF failure MessageBox is dropped (logged only). win-media-historyConditioningControlPanel/Windows/MediaHistoryWindow.xaml, MediaHistoryWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MediaHistoryWindow.axaml, MediaHistoryWindow.axaml.cswiredrows-media-history: MediaHistoryService + MediaHistoryPreviewRules moved to CCP.Core (WPF App.xaml.cs feeds Flash/Video events); Avalonia App creates/disposes it, FlashOverlay records images, MandatoryVideoScheduler.LastVideoPath records clips. Window (Assets tab > Media Log) reads the real log, live EntryAdded/Cleared, All/Images/Videos/Audio filters + search + count, row thumbnails (96 px LRU), folder button hidden for online rows, preview plan (file-not-found / audio card / streamed-only + Copy link (Copied 2 s) + Go to Source), muted looping video via LibVLC, animated GIF via SkiaSharp, Clear behind a confirm. wire-win-media-history: reveal SELECTS the file (WPF ExplorerLauncher) through ExternalOpener.Reveal: Explorer /select on Windows, open -R on macOS, freedesktop FileManager1.ShowItems (dbus-send) on Linux, the folder when the file is gone or the desktop cannot select; the Explorer command line moved to CCP.Core/Helpers/RevealArguments.cs (WPF ExplorerLauncher calls it). BtnPreviewLoad (Load preview) ported: shown only for an online still with remote-media consent, fetches into memory, following redirects by hand (5 hops, https->http refused, the guarded handler re-checks each host; WPF RemoteMediaCache follows them) (no RemoteMediaCache on this head, so the free RemoteCached path never applies), 720 px decode off the UI thread, generation guard, label_no_preview / streamed-only + retry on failure. The MediaFailed plate: MediaHistoryPreviewRules.VideoLooksBroken (empty, non-video bytes, or a strict container with no video head) shows label_file_not_found before LibVLC, which raised no error for an unreadable mp4. Tests: Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MediaHistoryWindowTests.cs (both facts, incl. MediaLog_reveals_the_file_and_loads_an_online_still_only_with_consent clicks BtnPreviewLoad, Online_still_fetch_follows_redirects_by_hand_and_stops_at_five_hops), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/RevealArgumentsTests.cs, Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/MediaHistoryServiceTests.cs, MandatoryVideoSchedulerTests.VideoStarted_fires_when_the_clip_is_shown. Compiled, not run: the Windows explorer.exe /select and macOS open -R branches of ExternalOpener.SelectNative, and WPF ExplorerRevealArgumentTests (WPF test project builds on Linux, cannot run). Live: ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-media-history/ (row0-5, video-a/b and gif-a/b frames differ, audio-filter, 0 binding errors). win-mini-playerConditioningControlPanel/Windows/MiniPlayerWindow.xaml, MiniPlayerWindow.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MiniPlayerWindow.axaml, MiniPlayerWindow.axaml.cswiredVideo playback is REAL (WPF behaviour: silent :no-audio preview, loop at end, play/pause button + Space, seek slider on release, 100 ms position timer, mm:ss time, Left/Right ±5 s, Esc/close, drag; teardown stops, disposes and frees the frame buffer). Proof: --video-check <file> [png] on the real desktop (frames change, seek to 70% lands at 0.70, pause freezes frames and flips the glyph, close disposes player/bitmap/buffer and LibVLC's threads end: 31 -> 21) and the same check headless in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerVideoTests.cs (skips without ffmpeg/libvlc); fail-proofs and screenshot in ~/ccp-port/evidence/video-miniplayer/. GIFs loop (WPF AnimationBehavior RepeatBehavior Forever): the still first frame shows at once, frames decode off the UI thread through SpiralOverlay's SkiaSharp decoder and a frame timer loops them until close (deviation: SpiralFrames caps 1280 px / 120 frames by stride / 300 MB cache, every frame at the first frame's delay, a delay outside 20-500 ms plays at 50 ms; decode logs say "Spiral:"). Load failures (image, video, LibVLC missing) show WPF's notice through MessageDialog (title_error + msg_image_load_failed / msg_video_load_failed / msg_video_playback_not_available_libvlc_not_initi), deferred to Opened because LoadFile runs before Show, then close. Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerPreviewTests.cs (GIF loop stepped by hand + teardown; broken image -> notice -> close; each fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mini-player/failproofs.txt). Opener (wire-win-mini-player): the Library tab's thumbnail double-click (WPF ThumbnailItem_Click: the first click toggles, ClickCount 2 previews) and context-menu Preview open it owned by the shell (AssetsTabView.OpenAssetPreview, WPF MainWindow.Assets.cs:1206); closing it re-activates the shell only while our process owns the foreground (WPF GetForegroundWindow pid check; AssetsTabView.AppInFront: Windows reuses EscapeClaim.CcpInFront, compiled not run here; elsewhere 'one of our windows is active', read at Closing). Tests AssetsTabTests.DoubleClickingAThumbnailOpensItInTheMiniPlayer (headless input never counts a double click, so the second press is raised with ClickCount 2) and AssetsTabTests.ContextMenuPreviewOpensAndClosingReactivatesTheShellOnlyWhileWeOwnTheForeground (fail-proven both ways: no re-activate -> 1/0; unguarded -> 0/1; double-click opener removed -> no preview; log ~/ccp-port/evidence/wire-win-mini-player/fail-proofs.txt). A zero foreground handle re-activates, as WPF MainWindow.Assets.cs:1241 does (CcpInFront(noForegroundCounts: true); the panic Escape check keeps false). WPF panic does not close the preview (not in GameSurfaces; it plays muted), so no PanicSurfaces line. Not here: pack-file previews (WPF temp-extracts pack entries) wait on the Content Packs tree node, which this head does not build yet (content-packs rows). No Keincheck run. Icons: divergent by decision: fluent-icons 2026-10-10 (lane icons-studio-features; WPF emoji/glyphs drawn as Fluent fx:IconGlyph/IconLabel/StrBare; before/after ~/ccp-port/evidence/icons/icons-studio-features/). Earlier ledger notes (retained for evidence; superseded where later work closes a gap): Video playback is REAL (WPF behaviour: silent :no-audio preview, loop at end, play/pause button + Space, seek slider on release, 100 ms position timer, mm:ss time, Left/Right ±5 s, Esc/close, drag; teardown stops, disposes and frees the frame buffer). Proof: --video-check <file> [png] on the real desktop (frames change, seek to 70% lands at 0.70, pause freezes frames and flips the glyph, close disposes player/bitmap/buffer and LibVLC's threads end: 31 -> 21) and the same check headless in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerVideoTests.cs (skips without ffmpeg/libvlc); fail-proofs and screenshot in ~/ccp-port/evidence/video-miniplayer/. GIFs loop (WPF AnimationBehavior RepeatBehavior Forever): the still first frame shows at once, frames decode off the UI thread through SpiralOverlay's SkiaSharp decoder and a frame timer loops them until close (deviation: SpiralFrames caps 1280 px / 120 frames by stride / 300 MB cache, every frame at the first frame's delay, a delay outside 20-500 ms plays at 50 ms; decode logs say "Spiral:"). Load failures (image, video, LibVLC missing) show WPF's notice through MessageDialog (title_error + msg_image_load_failed / msg_video_load_failed / msg_video_playback_not_available_libvlc_not_initi), deferred to Opened because LoadFile runs before Show, then close. Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/MiniPlayerPreviewTests.cs (GIF loop stepped by hand + teardown; broken image -> notice -> close; each fail-proven, ~/ccp-port/evidence/rows-mini-player/failproofs.txt). linux-package-flatpakinstaller/publishpackaging/flatpak/io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel.ymlwiredBuilt, installed and run for real (2026-10-30, flatpak 1.18.4, flatpak-builder 1.4.9 as org.flatpak.Builder, GNOME Sdk/Platform 50): tarball 7.1.15 from packaging/linux/build-tarball.sh, then flatpak run org.flatpak.Builder --user --install --force-clean --repo=<repo> --state-dir=<state> <build> <manifest> exit 0 after three manifest fixes, each a build failure first: vlc BUILDCC=gcc -std=gnu99 (configure: "Cannot find native C99 compiler"), vlc 3.0.21 -> 3.0.24 (3.0.21 fails on the Sdk FFmpeg: AVCodecContext has no member channels), and the tray own-name: org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-* is rejected at finish ("Invalid dbus name"), so the manifest lists -2-0..-2-3 (the app is pid 2 in the sandbox; n counts TrayIcon instances, and the app makes one. Avalonia 12.1.5 keeps that name across watcher restarts and catches a refused name, so -2-1..-2-3 only cover a failed RequestName retry. The 10-30 build shipped 12.1.2, which took a new name per restart. 2026-11-12: -<pid>-0 held through 5 restarts of a fake watcher on a private bus, dev build, not inside the Flatpak: ~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/flatpak-tray-restart-20261112/). Installed --smoke with CCP_SMOKE_BUNDLED_VOSK=1 passes every check incl. the bundled LibVLC clip and the Vosk model from /app/lib/ccp (exit 0). Real start on the live KDE Plasma Wayland session (app on XWayland :0), throwaway profile via --filesystem=<tmp> --env=CCP_USERDATA_DIR/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME=<tmp> (~/.var/app unchanged but flatpak's own .ld.so cache): splash 0.76 s, shell 5.8 s, interactive First run wizard 6.1 s, WM_CLASS = app id, tray name org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-2-0 owned through the proxy; KWin closeWindow() (WM_DELETE_WINDOW) on the windows exits flatpak run 0 (age gate unaccepted -> clean shutdown). WPE settled: not bundled, as the decision log now says (WebKitGTK default, WPE opt-in via CCP_LINUX_WEBVIEW=wpe with GTK fallback); in the sandbox webkit2gtk-4.1, libgstautodetect, libsecret, libXi resolve, the WPE trio does not, libvlc from /app. Evidence: ~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/flatpak-20261030/. Re-run on port/7.2 (2026-11-04, ca0d0a3b8f, tarball 7.2.1): flatpak-builder fails on the unpatched manifest (no BUILDCC) and passes with these three fixes; install, sandbox --smoke 9/9 (LibVLC clip, Vosk from /app/lib/ccp) and the sandbox library check pass, all headless, no live GUI start that time, so the window path and tray own-names are proven on 7.1.15 only (~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/preview-72-20261104/). Not verified: a web page actually rendering in the Flatpak (behind the age gate), a native-Wayland run (X11 only by design), a watcher restart inside the Flatpak, Keincheck voice, panic key / overlays / portal from the Flatpak on this base, a clean machine, the RT-ENGINE-NOTICES.txt licence install (#3849 landed after the 11-04 run). linux-package-flatpakinstaller/publishpackaging/flatpak/io.github.CodeBambi.ConditioningControlPanel.ymlwiredBuilt, installed and run for real (2026-10-30, flatpak 1.18.4, flatpak-builder 1.4.9 as org.flatpak.Builder, GNOME Sdk/Platform 50): tarball 7.1.15 from packaging/linux/build-tarball.sh, then flatpak run org.flatpak.Builder --user --install --force-clean --repo=<repo> --state-dir=<state> <build> <manifest> exit 0 after three manifest fixes, each a build failure first: vlc BUILDCC=gcc -std=gnu99 (configure: "Cannot find native C99 compiler"), vlc 3.0.21 -> 3.0.24 (3.0.21 fails on the Sdk FFmpeg: AVCodecContext has no member channels), and the tray own-name: org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-* is rejected at finish ("Invalid dbus name"), so the manifest lists -2-0..-2-3 (the app is pid 2 in the sandbox; n counts TrayIcon instances, and the app makes one. Avalonia 12.1.5 keeps that name across watcher restarts and catches a refused name, so -2-1..-2-3 only cover a failed RequestName retry. The 10-30 build shipped 12.1.2, which took a new name per restart. 2026-11-12: -<pid>-0 held through 5 restarts of a fake watcher on a private bus, dev build, not inside the Flatpak: ~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/flatpak-tray-restart-20261112/).
