Real start on the live KDE Plasma Wayland session (app on XWayland :0), throwaway profile via --filesystem=<tmp> --env=CCP_USERDATA_DIR/XDG_CONFIG_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME/XDG_CACHE_HOME=<tmp> (~/.var/app unchanged but flatpak's own .ld.so cache): splash 0.76 s, shell 5.8 s, interactive First run wizard 6.1 s, WM_CLASS = app id, tray name org.kde.StatusNotifierItem-2-0 owned through the proxy; KWin closeWindow() (WM_DELETE_WINDOW) on the windows exits flatpak run 0 (age gate unaccepted -> clean shutdown). WPE settled: not bundled, as the decision log now says (WebKitGTK default, WPE opt-in via CCP_LINUX_WEBVIEW=wpe with GTK fallback); in the sandbox webkit2gtk-4.1, libgstautodetect, libsecret, libXi resolve, the WPE trio does not, libvlc from /app. Evidence: ~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/flatpak-20261030/. Re-run on port/7.2 (2026-11-04, ca0d0a3b8f, tarball 7.2.1): flatpak-builder fails on the unpatched manifest (no BUILDCC) and passes with these three fixes; install, sandbox --smoke 9/9 (LibVLC clip, Vosk from /app/lib/ccp) and the sandbox library check pass, all headless, no live GUI start that time, so the window path and tray own-names are proven on 7.1.15 only (~/ccp-port/evidence/linux-package/preview-72-20261104/). Not verified: a web page actually rendering in the Flatpak (behind the age gate), a native-Wayland run (X11 only by design), a watcher restart inside the Flatpak, Keincheck voice, panic key / overlays / portal from the Flatpak on this base, a clean machine, the RT-ENGINE-NOTICES.txt licence install (#3849 landed after the 11-04 run). Missing: the .flatpak bundle on the linux-preview-<version> pre-release (local repo only so far; no preview OSTree repo or .flatpakref, see avalonia-linux-install.html). 2026-11-05 (Linux beta 1, lane linux-race): #3849 adds RT-ENGINE-NOTICES.txt to the licence install and records why Racing Thoughts needs no new grants (network, ipc and dri are already there; Electron is fetched on the first race into the app data dir, never bundled); inside Flatpak the Chromium sandbox falls back to --no-sandbox (packaging/linux/rt-engine-check.sh). Shipping the race engine is blocked on the owner/legal call on Electron's ffmpeg codecs.

Tests: WorkshopRosterSwitchTests, WorkshopRosterPersonalityTests, WorkshopPhrasePresetTests, CompanionRosterSwitchTests.

views-tab-chasterConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.xaml.cs, ConditioningControlPanel/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.Fx.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/ChasterTabView.axaml(.cs) and partialsstubRead-only slice: header + account chip (lock, time left, chaster.app link), hero (title as LockTitle, see ctrl-lock-title, live d/h/m/s clock, ends line, setup hint, state pills), lock pick (one-tap / combo), unlinked ask with the Core loopback link flow + cancel + outcome note, the three facts; slice 2: Unlink (confirm dialog, revoke, token cleared from SecretStore, UI back to unlinked), Run-the-tab switch + one-time consent card (four facts), Pause pill (WPF :865-1072). Slice 3 (chaster-ladder): heads-up clock, raffle card and ladder scrap (see views-chaster-ladder-scrap). Slice 4 (chaster-receipt): the three numbers (balance, today + cap meter, this run) with the tab's receipt under them (ChasterTabView.Numbers.cs), the calendar sheet on Core LockCalendar (ChasterTabView.Calendar.cs: torn sheet + pin, cross/ring/padlock/key/elided cells + tooltips; crosses are straight strokes, no draw-in, no tonight tag) and 4. THE KEYS 2x2 on Core TabPresets (ChasterTabView.Keys.cs: rewrites ChasterPrices + RequestLimits, custom key rewrites nothing, stakes lines, Circe's mood refreshed as WPF RefreshPresets :1123; keys never touch the lock so no import confirm); a 30 s slow tick refreshes the hero (WPF :89) so the calendar rolls at midnight. Only Haptics uses the head property so far; the other 23 views stay under feat-adaptive-side-art. Trunk 5acf94a5f (HC10) imported: toy Test and pattern Play hang off one page CancellationTokenSource that ends on a rack module switch (the page itself is hidden) or when it leaves the tree; leaving Studio only hides StudioTab, so a preview keeps running until it ends or Panic, and HapticService.PanicStop (Core, so WPF too) now also cancels a per-toy test that drives the provider around the mixer (PanicSurfaces "haptics" already routes there). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/HapticsHeadTests.cs Tier1SideArtShowsWideAndFoldsBelowTheThreshold (fail-proven by dropping CollapseBelow from the page), PagePreviewStopsOnHideAndToyTestStopsOnPanic (fail-proven by reverting the PanicStop change), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/SideArtCollapseTests.cs. Difference from WPF: Avalonia also stops the page's own buzz (Test/Play) on a rack module switch (the test hides the page directly, not through the rack); WPF MainWindow.Haptics.cs:663/1087 has no preview cancel and lets it run out. Note: the page StackPanel is centred (as on WPF), so the region is as wide as its content; in the default 1100x780 render it stays under 1000px and the plate is folded. The plate has only been seen in the headless test that sizes the Grid to 1200px; no render or real-shell check shows it yet, and whether WPF folds at the same window width is not measured. WPF AdaptiveSideArt.cs edit compiled only through the WPF test project build, not run. (views-tab-haptics-enable-gate.txt), Intiface URL row shows when ticked, 0 binding errors. rows-haptics-tab: the VMs (HapticUiModels.cs) moved to Core CCP.Core/Views/Controls/ (git mv; Visibility props -> ShowMode/HasBattery bools, WPF XAML binds them through BoolToVis, converters stay in the WPF head as HapticUiConverters.cs) with the WPF builders (HapticRoutingGroupVm.BuildDefault, HapticToyCardVm.ShapeSignature, HapticProviderChipVm.BuildDefault/Sync) that WPF now calls too. Not driven against a real toy or Intiface (sandbox has no premium, so the page is veiled); wire-views-tab-haptics: the Tier-1 side-art column is back (HapticsSideArt, WPF HapticsTabView.xaml:901: 3*/2* split, settings column MaxWidth 780, scrim, vibe.png painted mod-first by ApplyFeatureArt) behind a head port of WPF Features/AdaptiveSideArt.cs (CCP.Avalonia/Helpers/AdaptiveSideArt.cs, CollapseBelow=1000: folds the last column, hides the plate, lifts the settings MaxWidth); the #1321 hysteresis rule moved to Core CCP.Core/Helpers/SideArtCollapse.cs (WPF AdaptiveSideArt delegates). Only Haptics uses the head property so far; the other 23 views stay under feat-adaptive-side-art. Trunk 5acf94a5f (HC10) imported: toy Test and pattern Play hang off one page CancellationTokenSource that ends on a rack module switch (the page itself is hidden) or when it leaves the tree; leaving Studio only hides StudioTab, so a preview keeps running until it ends or Panic, and HapticService.PanicStop (Core, so WPF too) now also cancels a per-toy test that drives the provider around the mixer (PanicSurfaces "haptics" already routes there). Tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/HapticsHeadTests.cs Tier1SideArtShowsWideAndFoldsBelowTheThreshold (fail-proven by dropping CollapseBelow from the page), PagePreviewStopsOnHideAndToyTestStopsOnPanic (fail-proven by reverting the PanicStop change), Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/SideArtCollapseTests.cs. Difference from WPF: Avalonia also stops the page's own buzz (Test/Play) on a rack module switch (the test hides the page directly, not through the rack); WPF MainWindow.Haptics.cs:663/1087 has no preview cancel and lets it run out. Note: the page StackPanel is centred (as on WPF), so the region is as wide as its content; in the default 1100x780 render it stays under 1000px and the plate is folded. The plate has only been seen in the headless test that sizes the Grid to 1200px; no render or real-shell check shows it yet, and whether WPF folds at the same window width is not measured. WPF AdaptiveSideArt.cs edit compiled only through the WPF test project build, not run. Difference from WPF: Avalonia also stops the page's own buzz (Test/Play) on a rack module switch (the test hides the page directly, not through the rack); WPF MainWindow.Haptics.cs:663/1087 has no preview cancel and lets it run out. Note: the page StackPanel is centred (as on WPF), so the region is as wide as its content; in the default 1100x780 render it stays under 1000px and the plate is folded. Ported: focus live intake before gates (CCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/GradedIntakeTabView.axaml.cs:170; WPF ConditioningControlPanel/MainWindow/MainWindow.Lab.cs:154); spent CTA priced Basic card or reconnect (:189; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.Patreon.cs:193; WPF MainWindow.Lab.cs:184, MainWindow.QuestsTab.cs:96); live history before disk for duck (:204; WPF MainWindow.Lab.cs:198). Saved drafts queue credit (CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/IntakeHostWindow.cs:169; WPF ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Quiz/IntakeHostService.cs:586); matching session earns at 50% or natural completion (CCP.Avalonia/App.Intake.cs:9; WPF ConditioningControlPanel/MainWindow/MainWindow.Presets.cs:1653/1861). Shared service CCP.Core/Services/Progression/IntakePunchCardService.cs:86 uses CoreDispatch and 30 s saves (:98), flushes on shutdown (:380; CCP.Avalonia/App.axaml.cs:1290; WPF App.xaml.cs:2801/6522), UI stays hidden (:61; WPF original service:60). Already on base: pass/AI gates, art, page/media/speech bridge, achievement signals and draft toast (GradedIntakeTabView.axaml.cs:166/229; IntakeHostWindow.cs:156/178); fullscreen, duck/restore, heartbeat and panic registry (IntakeHostWindow.Lifecycle.cs:1; WPF IntakeHostService.cs:109/1025/1077). Tests: IntakeHostWindowTests, IntakeSessionCreditTests, IntakeLifecycleTests.BeginUsesUnsavedIntakeHistoryToDuck, VaultGateTests.SpentIntakeToastOpensThePricedIntakeCard, WPF IntakePunchCardTests linked into Core. Missing: EMI Desk intakeRunning Fire/ReleaseHold (WPF IntakeHostService.cs:114/1077; no director integration here); native process-failed recovery (WPF IntakeHostService.cs:164/1025; WebHost lacks that event). Live page visual/audio playback and toast click on a supported native engine remain unproven. Stub retained pending these gaps. Review P2 fix: CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.Patreon.cs:195 refuses OpenPricedCard before reconnect or price-card routing while Lockdown is active, matching this head's other guarded doors (same file:184/226) and the WPF Lockdown interaction restriction (ConditioningControlPanel/MainWindow/MainWindow.Lab.cs:605/611; priced routing remains MainWindow.QuestsTab.cs:96). Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/VaultGateTests.cs:322 raises the spent toast before activating Lockdown, then clicks its CTA and asserts zero reconnects and no vault dialog; deactivation still permits reconnect and priced-card routing. Fail-proven against the unguarded code (expected reconnects 0, actual 1). Earlier evidence and missing behaviour above remain unchanged. Start failures now close and warn: CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/IntakeHostWindow.cs:125 and CCP.Avalonia/Views/Tabs/GradedIntakeTabView.axaml.cs:208 (WPF ConditioningControlPanel/Services/Quiz/IntakeHostService.cs:716, MainWindow/MainWindow.Lab.cs:201). Tests: IntakeHostWindowTests.BootErrorClosesThenWarnsOnce and LaunchFailureClosesAndWarnsOnce, each fail-proven. Takeaway shelf rows belong to shell-takeaway (this tab paints WPF's empty state). The session-scoped corner GIF now runs: Core SessionRunner (WPF SessionEngine.cs:198/356/531/575/862-896/1731-1797/2126-2320) raises it at start when admitted, re-asks admission every tick and on RefreshCornerGifPolicy (Spiral card's session switch, a standalone slot change, the fullscreen spiral leaving), delayed start/end minute (ours: no re-raise past the end minute, WPF flickers), hides it on pause, hands the corner back on the terminal close; admission rules moved to Core CornerGifPlanner (WPF CornerGifMedia forwards). CornerGifOverlay draws it as a session slot (no stagger, no Spiral-Library fallback, outside the standalone sentinel); standalone slots stand down while it is up; panic closes it (corner-gif surface) and pauses the session. Card sheen (WPF OnPresetsTabVisibilityChanged/RefreshCardSheen): on the selected preset chip or rack row while the tab is shown, the window active and not minimised, and ambient loops allowed; dropped on hide. Rack rows: action buttons only under the pointer (WPF SdRackActions; transparent, unhittable and out of the Tab order at rest, like WPF Hidden). Catalogue chip drag-over icon states: nothing to port, WPF's SessionDropZone_DragEnter/Over/Leave/Drop are never subscribed (PresetsTabView.xaml:914 hooks only MouseLeftButtonUp). Takeaway shelf rows belong to shell-takeaway (this tab paints WPF's empty state). CornerGifOverlay draws it as a session slot (no stagger, no Spiral-Library fallback, outside the standalone sentinel); standalone slots stand down while it is up; panic closes it (corner-gif surface) and pauses the session. Card sheen (WPF OnPresetsTabVisibilityChanged/RefreshCardSheen): on the selected preset chip or rack row while the tab is shown, the window active and not minimised, and ambient loops allowed; dropped on hide. Rack rows: action buttons only under the pointer (WPF SdRackActions; transparent, unhittable and out of the Tab order at rest, like WPF Hidden). Catalogue chip drag-over icon states: nothing to port, WPF's SessionDropZone_DragEnter/Over/Leave/Drop are never subscribed (PresetsTabView.xaml:914 hooks only MouseLeftButtonUp). Takeaway shelf rows belong to shell-takeaway (this tab paints WPF's empty state). dialogs-local-ai-setup-wizardConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.xaml.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Dialogs/LocalAiSetupWizard.axaml.cswiredEvery step drives OllamaSetupService, which moved to Core unchanged apart from a non-Windows PATH lookup: detect, start ollama serve, installer download and silent install (Windows only), model pull with progress, smoke test, Finish saving Local, Retry, and Cancel that cancels the running step. Off Windows there is no auto-install: the consent lines say to install Ollama yourself, and Continue re-detects (an error says so when Ollama is still missing; the start-failed error gives the systemctl and ollama serve commands) (docs/avalonia-decisions.html 2026-10-09). The manual-install links work from the keyboard. The head now seeds LocalAiService.EnsureServerRunning and calls StopSpawnedServer on exit. feat-bubble-countConditioningControlPanel/Features/BubbleCountFeatureControl.xaml, ConditioningControlPanel/Features/BubbleCountFeatureControl.xaml.cs; ConditioningControlPanel/Services/BubbleCountService.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Features/BubbleCountFeatureControl.axaml, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Features/BubbleCountFeatureControl.axaml.cs; CCP.Core/Services/BubbleCountScheduler.cs; CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/BubbleCountHost.csstubStudio > Bubble Count: enable/live schedule, frequency, difficulty, strict warning and Test Now reach the Core scheduler and existing game/result windows. Existing schedule, 800 ms Freeze lead-in, duration-scaled XP/cooldown, quests, achievements, retry/Mercy, monitor targeting and ambient-bubble pause remain wired. Active pack clips already join through PackMediaPool (PackMediaPoolTests, ContentPacksWireTests); removed stale Missing claim. fin-feat-bubble-count: visible For You feed defers one coalesced game, polls every 500 ms and expires after 90 s; replay rechecks running/enabled; stop/panic cancels it. Pause other effects editor persists/rebinds; its choice is latched through lead-in, retry and Mercy, stops flashes and takes the existing video bouncing-text hold; normal end resumes only previously running flashes while engine/setting remain on, force cleanup never restarts them. Empty-library warning is localized, distinguishes installed-but-inactive packs, tells once per launch for scheduled rounds and on every Test Now. Proof: BubbleCountSchedulerTests (23 passing Core cases; 11 regression failures before fixes), BubbleCountQueueTests (settings, visible feed, toast and stop paths compiled for headless supervision). Missing: shared InteractionQueueService, reciprocal Video/LockCard/PopQuiz deferral during a game and typed duration+120 s stuck-timeout extension; shared overlay z-order reconciliation for the effects hold (shell-clickthrough-overlays); ghost-feed state (feat-fyp-host); browser playback/poisoned-native routing (shell-video-playback / win-bubble-count). Deviations: a game waiting behind a mandatory video / lock card / pop quiz re-checks every 1 s (QueuePoll), so the handover lags up to 1 s where WPF's InteractionQueue dequeues the moment the other interaction completes; engine Stop cancels a For You-deferred game, including a deferred Test Now, whereas WPF's defer timer survives Stop. Proof: Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/BubbleCountSchedulerTests.cs, live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/bubble-count-live/feat-bubble-count.png + win-bubble-count-strict.txt. Proof: Tests/CCP.Core.Tests/BubbleCountSchedulerTests.cs (freeze fires with the game), Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/SubliminalWhisperShowTests.cs (order, 300 ms, Reset window, muted, 10% skip), all fail-proven; live ~/ccp-port/evidence/avalonia-port/bambi-freeze/ (Test Now -> whisper stream, "Bambi Freeze" cards on 3 screens, game at +0.8 s, Reset whisper + cards at +5.2 s; 0 binding errors). ctrl-chaster-booked-popConditioningControlPanel/Controls/ChasterBookedPop.cs, MainWindow/MainWindow.Chaster.cs:84-158; ConditioningControlPanel/Controls/ChasterBookedPop.csCCP.Avalonia/Views/Overlays/ChasterBookedPop.cs, CCP.Avalonia/Views/Windows/MainShellWindow.ChasterFlash.cs; Core Services/Chaster/BookedPopLayout.cs, CapNotice.cs (moved from the WPF head; Point/Rect -> ScreenPoint/AvatarTubeLayout.Box, tip quiz-core-a shape)wiredA booking pops the outlined figure at its cause (NoteAt origin), else the X11 cursor, in its own click-through override-redirect window (X11Overlay, as BouncingText); stacked by Core PickSlot, placed by TopLeftPx on the screen under the origin; coalesced pops retitle with WPF's 180 ms re-punch; net zero dismisses. Restack note (#4359): Pointer grace now reads X11 desktop coordinates and falls back to panel hit testing when unavailable, which can collapse during popup overlap (CCP.Avalonia/Views/Chaos/ChaosHudWindow.axaml.cs:530; Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/ChaosHudGraceTests.cs; geometry and fallback fail-proven; window test compiled but could not run due to Inter font creation). Part B: pre-run sidebar lifecycle, loadout sync and actions remain missing (ChaosHubWindow.axaml.cs:1819, ChaosHudWindow.axaml.cs:842 and :1153); WPF ChaosHubWindow.xaml.cs:1747 and ChaosHudWindow.xaml.cs:263. Review: Win32 GetCursorPos supplies current desktop coordinates through CCP.Avalonia/Platform/Win32Overlay.cs:97 and ChaosHudWindow.axaml.cs:412; the window and collapse timer tests now run in Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/ChaosHudGraceTests.cs:78, superseding the earlier font limitation; the timer test failed when grace was replaced with hit testing. Native Wayland or a failed platform query still falls back to hit testing and can collapse under a popup; WPF ChaosHudWindow.xaml.cs:263 and :334. Blocker: without a desktop pointer source, popup overlap and movement past the halo cannot be distinguished from the last local position; X11Pointer.cs:15 cannot observe native Wayland windows and ChaosHudWindow.axaml.cs:539 falls back to hit testing. A compositor-supported current-pointer source is needed for WPF ChaosHudWindow.xaml.cs:334 parity. Follow-up: an unknown pointer no longer triggers collapse; the recheck waits for a current position and stops on close (CCP.Avalonia/Views/Chaos/ChaosHudWindow.axaml.cs:487; Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/ChaosHudGraceTests.cs:133, fail-proven by removing the unknown-position guard). This supersedes earlier fallback-collapse notes. If the query never recovers the HUD stays expanded; XWayland cannot observe a pointer over native Wayland windows (CCP.Avalonia/Platform/X11Pointer.cs:15), so full WPF ChaosHudWindow.xaml.cs:334 parity still needs a current desktop pointer source. Wayland grace (hand-ported from #4754 onto the hold-while-unknown model): CCP.Avalonia/Platform/X11Pointer.cs Read(out overWindow) reports whether an X surface has the pointer, and ChaosHudWindow.axaml.cs CursorInHudGrace ignores an unconfirmed XWayland position, so only the window hover can hold the halo open there; tests Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/ChaosHudGraceTests.cs.

Ported: live face - companion name, personality combo over PersonalityService.Shared writing through MainShellWindow.ActivatePersonalityPresetAsync (explicit gate; refusal puts the combo back; shell found via the window's Owner chain), sample lines from Core PersonalitySamples (quoted, italic; description fallback), follows PersonalityChanged, Turn it on (SetAvatarEnabled), Tube Fit link when the tube is live, perk row (CompanionPerks.Active) + v2 Change perk door (PerkPicker, writes CompanionPerk via Core CompanionPerks.TrySelect, shared with WPF SetPerk). Preview face: name, looks/personalities counts, first ModPersonality.SampleLines line via CompanionPreview (git mv to Core, unchanged). Test Tests/CCP.Avalonia.Tests/CompanionPickerCardTests.cs (card in a shell-owned window: combo -> ActivePersonalityPresetId + samples, gate Cancel reverts, perk write, preview face); selection->settings fail-proven (gate call removed -> red), the rest asserted, not fail-proven. Render: --render-view CompanionPickerCard (render-all includes it). Folded to avatar-tube-window: the Look combo lists only the tube's current set, disabled (tube cannot switch sets), and the portrait skips WPF's emote idle frame for pose 1. Not ported (stub): the 160 ms portrait fade-in (WPF CompanionPickerCard), the modmgr_avatar_single_hint (a single disabled set shows no hint), and restarting the XP-drain timer when the perk changes (PerkPicker.cs ponytail).
